Tell her these 10 things before it's too late. ⏳

Ruby is six, singing in the kitchen with a wooden spoon. 🎶 But according to a poll of 1,300+ girls, confidence drops by 30% between ages 8 and 14. So tell her now:

1️⃣ You are loved as you are. ❤️
2️⃣ You can say no. Your body belongs to you.
3️⃣ Never chase people who don't want you.
4️⃣ Your worth isn't in your looks.
5️⃣ Be kind, not a doormat.
6️⃣ Speak up when something is wrong.
7️⃣ Never make yourself small. Don't shrink.
8️⃣ Walk away from people who keep hurting you.
9️⃣ "I made a mistake" is not "I am a mistake."
🔟 I will always be a safe place. 🏠

"For man looketh on the outward appearance, but the LORD looketh on the heart." 1 Samuel 16:7

Jesus showed her what her worth really is. 🙏 And at sixteen, phone down, she comes and sits on your bed… and asks for your advice. ❤️

If worry is already making your little one quieter and smaller, you can walk the path together.

BravePath Kids is a Christ-centered 21-day journey for childhood anxiety, made for parents and kids to do together:
✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
🙏 Prayer
❤️ Love in action
Ages 4-6, 7-9 and 10-12.
